files_in_order: TalentTreeBase.lua (loaded by <Script file=> at Ascension_TalentUI.xml:3, before the template definition)
toc.toc_note: No ## Dependencies, no ## LoadOnDemand, no ## SavedVariables. Loads at login like any addon; it defines one virtual template and one mixin and shows nothing by itself. Its only consumer, Ascension_CoATalents, declares '## Dependencies: Ascension_TalentUI, Ascension_Collections' and is LoadOnDemand.

entry_points: None of its own. This addon defines the virtual Frame template 'TalentTreeBase' (Ascension_TalentUI.xml:5) and the global mixin TalentTreeBaseMixin; it creates no instance and registers no slash command, LoadUI function, micro button or Collections tab.

Instances are created by AddOns/Ascension_CoATalents/CoATalentFrame.xml:73 ($parentClassTree, parentKey ClassTree, inherits TalentTreeBase) and :114 ($parentSpecTree, parentKey SpecTree). That frame is CoATalentFrame (parent Collections, hidden).

Chain that opens it: Collections tab CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT is added as 'CoATalentFrame' when IsCustomClass() (AddOns/Ascension_Collections/Collections.lua:38) with pre-click CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI (Collections.lua:42) -> FrameXML/UIParent.lua:327 CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI() -> UIParentLoadAddOn("Ascension_CoATalents") when IsCustomClass() (UIParent.lua:329). FrameXML/Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua:473 also redirects LoadAddOn("Ascension_CharacterAdvancement") to _LoadAddOn("Ascension_CoATalents") for custom classes (:476).

The tree is first built when the consumer calls :SetClassTab(classDBC, tab) from CoATreeViewMixin:OnLoad (AddOns/Ascension_CoATalents/CoATreeViewMixin.lua:62 ClassTree, tab "Class") and CoATreeViewMixin:SetSpecID (:245 SpecTree, tab = spec DBC name). SetClassTab marks RebuildTree dirty; the actual BuildTree runs on the next OnUpdate tick (TalentTreeBase.lua:193 SetScript OnUpdate), so the natives are first hit one frame after the consumer's OnLoad, whether or not the frame is visible.

Redraws are driven by events: CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED (registered OnShow, TalentTreeBase.lua:39) and CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_ENTRY_PATCHED (registered OnLoad, :35), plus consumer calls to :MarkDirty(DirtyReason.Nodes|Search) (CoATreeViewMixin.lua:102-103, :251-252) and :ResetTree() (CoATreeViewMixin.lua:115, :122).

GetAllAttributes.note: NON-STOCK Frame method (stock 3.3.5a exposes only GetAttribute(name)); not in api-surface.tsv or ext-lua-bindings.tsv because neither inventory covers widget methods (SetAtlas/SetMaskedTexture are absent from them too); 0 hits in stock-ui-tree. Returns a name->value table of the frame's XML <Attributes>. Called during OnLoad of every TalentTreeBase instance, so without it the tree frame never gets getEntries/getNodeTemplate/... and BuildTree asserts. XML attributes are applied natively before any Lua runs, so a shim cannot intercept SetAttribute to learn them; the practical shim is to override AttributesToKeyValues (or add Frame:GetAllAttributes via the frame metatable) with a per-template known-name list -- for TalentTreeBase: getNodeTemplate, getConnectionTemplate, getChoiceNodeTemplate, getEntries, getPosition, buttonWidth, buttonHeight, buttonSpacingX, buttonSpacingY, useGates, getGateTemplate, getGateAttachmentPoint, gateCurrency, gateCurrencyCount, getEntryGateRequirement, and the consumer-added onlyOneGate -- read each with stock GetAttribute(name).

notes:
WHAT IT IS: a 366-line pure-Lua layout engine for a talent tree (node pool, choice/group nodes, connection lines, investment gates, dirty-flag update loop). It touches exactly four native C_CharacterAdvancement members (GetEntriesByClass, GetPendingTabAEInvestment, GetPendingTabTEInvestment, ClearPendingBuildByTab), C_Logger.Error, and one non-stock widget method (GetAllAttributes); everything else it calls is Ascension SharedXML/FrameXML Lua that the shim ships verbatim. Its single consumer is Ascension_CoATalents (ClassTree + SpecTree); it is the whole CoA talent-tree renderer, so it is first-release scope.

CLASS/TAB IDENTITY: self.class and self.tab are DBC NAME strings ("Tinker", "General", ...) and ("Class" | spec DBC name like "Arms"), produced by ClassConversions in FrameXML/Util/CharacterAdvancementUtil.lua. Every native call and the ENTRY_PATCHED payload use these exact strings (string ==), so the shim's Data.lua accessors and any EVENT it fires must use the same names, not class bytes or file tokens.

UPDATE LOOP: MarkDirty sets a flag and hooks OnUpdate; Update() drains ONE flag per frame (next(self.dirty)) and unhooks when empty. BuildTree schedules RebuildGates and RebuildConnections, so a tree appears over three consecutive frames; a Lua error inside any stage leaves OnUpdate hooked and re-raises every frame (error spam) -- the shim's natives must never throw. RebuildTree wipes all other flags (:160).

LATENT BUG (Ascension's own): self.getEntry is used at TalentTreeBase.lua:219 but is set by no XML attribute and no Lua anywhere in the tree. It is reached only when CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_ENTRY_PATCHED fires with isNew == false for the currently displayed class/tab. Shim options: never fire ENTRY_PATCHED with isNew=false (static data makes it unnecessary), or set TalentTreeBaseMixin.getEntry = C_CharacterAdvancement.GetEntryByInternalID (native present in ext-lua-bindings, 0x101772b0) from the shim so MixinAndLoadScripts copies it onto every instance.

DEAD DEFAULTS: six of the base template's attribute defaults point at CharacterAdvancementUtil functions that do not exist anywhere (GetDisplayTemplateForEntry/ForConnection/ForEntryChoice/ForGate, GetGateAttachmentPoint, GetEntryAEGateRequirement); StringToGlobalTableEntry returns nil for them. Only getEntries (C_CharacterAdvancement.GetEntriesByClass) and getPosition (CharacterAdvancementUtil.GetEntryPosition) are live defaults. The consumer overrides all six, so this is harmless today but any new consumer must do the same; useGates defaults to false so the gate path is skipped unless overridden.

GETALLATTRIBUTES: AttributesToKeyValues copies every XML attribute onto the frame and then SetAttribute(name, nil)s it. Because XML attributes are applied natively before OnLoad and stock exposes only GetAttribute(name), the shim must either add Frame:GetAllAttributes via the frame metatable (impossible to enumerate natively on stock) or override AttributesToKeyValues with a per-template known-name list (15 names in this template + onlyOneGate) read through GetAttribute. Do this in the shim BEFORE Ascension's SharedXML Util.lua is loaded or re-define it after.

GETPENDINGTABTEINVESTMENT: classed NATIVE by the P0 inventory (string present in Extensions.dll) but absent from ext-lua-bindings.tsv and ca-lua-bindings.txt while its AE twin and the Class/Global TE variants are present; the CA binding table has unlisted slots at [esp+0x3d0..0x3dc] exactly where it would sit, so treat as a scanner miss. The SpecTree asserts on it at CreateGates, so the shim must define it regardless. Contract mirrors the AE one; both take a literal 0 third argument at every callsite in the tree (meaning unknown); other Ascension callers guard the result with `or 0`, this addon does not.

GATES: a gate is created per distinct getEntryGateRequirement value (entry.RequiredTab{AE,TE}Investment > 0), sorted ascending; with the consumer's onlyOneGate=true only the lowest still-locked gate is shown. gate:UpdateDisplay(count) compares count < required; getGateAttachmentPoint(nodes) must return 5 values for SetPoint and error()s on an empty node list.

CHOICE NODES: entries sharing a non-zero Group get ONE choice-node button (template from getChoiceNodeTemplate) at the position of the first sibling; each sibling node is still created and then reparented into the choice node by AddNode; connections from/to a grouped entry are re-targeted to its choice node (:282-283, :297-298). ConnectedNodes must reference IDs within the same class+tab list or C_Logger.Error fires per dangling edge.

POSITIONS: for CoA classes GetEntryPosition returns entry.PositionX/PositionY (default classes: Column/Row) and SimpleGridXY turns them into TOPLEFT offsets ((w+sx)*col-1, -((h+sy)*row-1)) with the consumer's 30x30 buttons and 14px spacing -- so PositionX/Y in the data tables are 1-based grid coordinates, not pixels.

RESET: ResetTree -> ClearPendingBuildByTab(class, tab, true-for-CoA) and then WAITS for CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED to redraw; the shim's implementation must fire that event (while the tree is shown) or the reset is invisible.

EVENTS: PENDING_BUILD_UPDATED is registered only while shown (OnShow/OnHide) and carries no payload; ENTRY_PATCHED is registered for life in OnLoad, payload (isNew, class, tab, entryID) with class "None" ignored, and this addon is the only registrant in the tree -- a first release can simply never fire it. Two CallbackRegistry names (UPDATE_CURRENCY_DISPLAY, TREE_UPDATE) are generated but never triggered.

CROSS-CHECK: api-surface.tsv marks C_Logger.Error as present in stock Wow.exe -- substring artifact, stock has no C_Logger. Neither TSV covers widget methods, so their silence on GetAllAttributes/ClearAndSetPoint is not evidence either way; the 0 hits in stock-ui-tree and the absence of any Lua definition are.
